acceptance_basis: Preserve substantial painting engagement and readable phone labels; no mandatory six-color rule. Small fixed details are acceptable; prominent colored features must not be removed from play merely to meet clearance.
limitations: Static visual review only; no native UI or touch test. Reward video not independently reviewed.
No generation, processor, audit, build or emulator run. Only requested review JSON files written.
scope: Final processed visual gate for this exact bundle only.
bundle_hash_algorithm: SHA256; concatenate each filename encoded UTF-8 then its raw file bytes, in bundle_file_order; no delimiters
inspection_method: Individually viewed current run source, final processed original and existing 344px phone-preview.png. Compared visible label numbers with current data.json. Phone rendering is an approximation.
prior_revision_reassessment: Revision 5 rejection based solely on fewer than six meaningful colors is not adopted. Current verdict is based on lost substantial paintable features.
observations: Source has exactly eight arms: four on each side; silhouette, eyes and smile remain recognizable. Star, shell and seaweed have no faces.
Only four labels remain: purple octopus, orange star, yellow hat and turquoise shell. Existing phone labels are distinguishable.
All eight prominent coral inner-arm panels and the entire green seaweed are already colored before play. This removes repeated arm-painting opportunities and a whole contrasting prop.

defects.description: Coral arm panels and green seaweed are fixed artwork, leaving only four paint targets.
defects.action: Locally widen coral panels and green leaf interiors so they survive the existing 20px radius filter and comfortably fit phone labels; retain all eight arms.

geometry_evidence.provenance: Measurements supplied in task; not recomputed by an audit.
geometry_evidence.interpretation: Radius and glyph height are different measures: a roughly 30px glyph height does not imply a 30px radius requirement. Current shapes fail the 20px radius filter; merely restoring labels without checking their full bounding boxes is insufficient.
